name: Rico (Friendly)
description:
A stocky man in his late thirties with a broad chest and thick forearms built from decades of dock work, standing with shoulders rolled back and arms naturally spaced wide in an open, inviting posture. His face is broad-jawed with a rounded softness around the cheeks and kind crinkles at the eyes suggesting frequent smiling, with relaxed facial muscles and a warm, genuine expression that puts others at ease. His stance is grounded and centered, weight evenly distributed with a slight forward lean that conveys approachability and calm confidence.

T-pose, humanoid, game character, realistic proportions.
